items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘新加坡大奖赛排位赛夺冠
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘在新加坡大奖赛排位赛中击败法拉利车队，夺得杆位，这是他完美周末的延续。查尔斯·勒克莱尔是他在排位赛中的最接近的对手，而基米·安东内利将在第二排与汉密尔顿并肩作战。

items.originalTitle: Verstappen beats Ferraris to Singapore GP pole
detailZh: 维斯塔潘在新加坡大奖赛排位赛中击败法拉利车队，夺得杆位，这是他完美周末的延续。
维斯塔潘在排位赛中的首次Q3飞驰圈速为1分31.373秒，这足以让他领先，继他的冲刺赛杆位和胜利之后。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔驾驶的法拉利是他在排位赛中的最接近的对手，他的圈速比维斯塔潘慢了0.054秒。刘易斯·汉密尔顿使两辆法拉利都进入了前三名，仅比勒克莱尔慢0.069秒。
基米·安东内利将在第二排与汉密尔顿并肩作战，他在升级后的梅赛德斯中排名第四快。
麦克拉伦车手在冲刺赛中发生碰撞，将共享第三排的位置。
兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在排位赛中分别获得第五和第七名，乔治·罗素在他们的老款梅赛德斯之间，但罗素将因为引擎处罚而移至最后一排。
皮埃尔·加斯利在排位赛中赢得了F1的中场战斗，以第八名的成绩（在赛道上将是第七名）击败了小红牛车队组合利亚姆·劳森和阿维德·林德布拉德。
奥迪的尼克·胡肯伯格是Q2中被淘汰的最快车手，仅比Q3的位置慢了0.182秒。
哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼和埃斯特班·奥康分别排在第12和第13位，领先于卡洛斯·塞恩斯的威廉姆斯车队、奥迪车队的加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和阿尔皮纳车队的弗朗哥·科拉平托，比队友加斯利慢了一秒以上。
两辆阿斯顿·马丁赛车在排位赛第一阶段出现故障，费尔南多·阿隆索报告了涡轮问题，他认为这意味着车队应该为他更换赛车动力单元以参加比赛。
他排名第17，略高于亚历克斯·阿隆的威廉姆斯车队，并且比队友兰斯·斯特罗尔快了七十分之一秒，就像他在冲刺排位赛中的表现一样。
塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯领先于凯迪拉克车队的瓦尔特里·博塔斯，两人是排位赛中设置最快圈速的两位最慢车手。
哈贾尔在新加坡的噩梦周六继续，他在Q1甚至无法完成一圈计时赛之前就停了下来。
哈贾尔设法将他的小红牛赛车开回维修区，然后再次出发，但再次遇到了问题。他将在周日的比赛中从后方的惩罚车手开始发车。
17号阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+0.223秒进入Q2
detailEn: Max Verstappen’s perfect Singapore weekend continued as he claimed pole position for the grand prix, beating the Ferraris in Formula 1 qualifying.
Verstappen’s first Q3 flying lap - a 1m31.373s - ended up being good enough to top qualifying, following on from his sprint race pole and victory.
Charles Leclerc’s Ferrari was his closest challenger, setting a lap 0.054s slower than Verstappen’s. Lewis Hamilton made it two Ferraris in the top three, just 0.069s adrift of Leclerc.
Kimi Antonelli will line up on the second row alongside Hamilton, having been fourth-quickest in the upgraded Mercedes.
The McLaren drivers, who collided in the sprint race, will share the third row.
Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri were fifth and seventh in qualifying with George Russell between them in the older-spec Mercedes, but Russell will move to the back of the grid with an engine penalty.
Pierre Gasly won F1’s midfield fight in qualifying, qualifying eighth (which is set to become seventh on the grid) and beating the Racing Bulls duo of Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad.
Audi’s Nico Hulkenberg was the quickest driver knocked out in Q2, 0.182s away from a place in Q3.
Haas drivers Ollie Bearman and Esteban Ocon were 12th and 13th ahead of Carlos Sainz’s Williams, Audi’s Gabriel Bortoleto and Alpine’s Franco Colapinto, over a second slower than team-mate Gasly.
Both Aston Martins fell in the first stage of qualifying after Fernando Alonso reported a turbo issue, which he thinks means his team should change his power unit for the race.
He qualified 17th, just ahead of Alex Albon’s Williams and still seven tenths clear of team-mate Lance Stroll, just as he was in sprint qualifying.
Sergio Perez led Cadillac team-mate Valtteri Bottas, the pair the two slowest drivers to set a lap in qualifying.
Isack Hadjar’s nightmare Saturday in Singapore continued as he ground to a halt before he could even set a timed lap in Q1.
Hadjar managed to return his Red Bull to the garage, then came out again and encountered an issue again. He will start among the penalised drivers at the back of the field on Sunday.
10 Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +1.408s
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +0.223s to Q2

这意味着维斯塔潘不需要提高他的最后一圈表现，他没有这样做，并确保了里程碑式的第50个大奖赛杆位，但这是他在新加坡滨海湾街道赛道的10次尝试中的第一次。

然而，红牛车队的一天并不完美，因为伊萨克·哈迪亚尔在Q1的赛车变速箱问题阻止了他设置圈速，这意味着他将和受罚的拉塞尔一起在滨海湾街道赛道的最后方发车，这个赛道很难超车。
哈迪亚尔的早退给了中游车队的机会来缩小差距，皮埃尔·加斯利在Q3中击败了小红牛车队的利亚姆·劳森和阿维德·林德布拉德，获得了第八快的成绩，这在发车位上变成了第七位。
尼科·胡肯伯格差点错过了奥迪的Q3排位，但由于拉塞尔的处罚，他将从第10位起步。

detailEn: Singapore GP Qualifying: Max Verstappen claims pole position again as Charles Leclerc pips Lewis Hamilton to second on grid

Max Verstappen's late-season surge continues after he turns tables on Ferrari in Q3; Charles Leclerc usurps team-mate Lewis Hamilton for second on final laps; Kimi Antonelli fourth; watch Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix at 1pm (build-up from 11.30am) live on Sky Sports F1
Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix.

Max Verstappen claimed his second pole position of the Singapore Grand Prix weekend to put himself at the head of the grid for Sunday's main race as Ferrari's wait for a first full pole of 2026 continued.

Lewis Hamilton had looked the favourite to deliver his first Grand Prix pole for Ferrari after topping the first two stages of qualifying but Red Bull rival Verstappen, who had won the day's earlier rain-hit Sprint having started on pole, seized the initiative in the first runs of Q3.

Hamilton was a provisional second after the first runs but could not improve on his second attempt, and was then knocked off the front row to third by team-mate Charles Leclerc, who had experienced a low-key session up to then.

It meant Verstappen did not need to improve his final lap, which he did not, and he secured a milestone 50th Grand Prix pole but his first ever in 10 attempts at Singapore's Marina Bay street circuit.
The four-time world champion will now bid to win the race for the first time on Sunday, live on Sky Sports F1 at 1pm, and secure back-to-back victories after triumphing in Malaysia last week.
The battle for pole ultimately proved an exclusive Verstappen versus Ferrari affair with neither championship leaders Mercedes nor reigning champions McLaren truly in the mix.
Max Verstappen claims pole with Charles Leclerc in P2 and teammate Lewis Hamilton in P3 ahead of the Singapore Grand Prix.
Championship leader Kimi Antonelli got closest to the front but qualified fourth after abandoning his final lap.

Mercedes team-mate George Russell, who crashed out from the lead of the Sprint in the wet, was sixth but always knew he would drop to the back of Sunday's grid whatever he did in main qualifying due to a large engine-change penalty.

After colliding on the final lap in the earlier Sprint, McLaren team-mates Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri took fifth and seventh respectively. Russell's penalty means they will start together on the third row.
Sky Sports F1's Karun Chandhok dissects who was at fault for the collision between the two McLaren's which saw Oscar Piastri crash out of the Singapore GP Sprint race.

Red Bull's day was not perfect, however, as gearbox issues on Isack Hadjar's car in Q1 prevented him from setting a lap time and means he will join the penalised Russell at the back of the grid at a Marina Bay street circuit that is very difficult to overtake on.

Hadjar's early demise offered the chance for the midfield runners to gain ground and Pierre Gasly beat the Racing Bulls duo of Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad to the eighth-fastest time of Q3, which becomes seventh on the grid.
Nico Hulkenberg just missed out on Q3 for Audi but will start 10th owing to Russell's penalty.
